data.action: 立于沙盘长桌前双手展开烫金卷轴，沉稳微笑
data.animaCaption: Standing beside a carved map table inside a grand marble council hall, she holds an unfurled gilded scroll in her crimson velvet toga and meets the viewer's gaze with composed authority.
data.camera: 中景，平视，地图沙盘与大理石雕像背景
data.description: 壁画环绕的七丘元老院议事厅内，奥古斯塔身着暗红金边单肩托加礼袍，立于青铜沙盘与长桌前审阅烫金城邦盟约卷轴。
data.lighting: 拱顶天窗倾泻的温暖日光束
data.promptProse: Beside an engraved strategy table inside Septimont's senate chamber, Augusta wears a one-shoulder crimson velvet toga over a pleated ivory gown, holding an unfurled parchment treaty.
data.title: 奥古斯塔 · 元老院议事厅审阅烫金城邦卷轴
